claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Bill Davis at Chouteau Island in January 1869.
claims.excerpt: In January, 1869, Tom Allen whipped Bill Davis at Chouteau island

claims.statement: Charley Gallagher knocked Tom Allen out of time on Carroll Island near St. Louis on February 23, 1869.
claims.excerpt: Charley Gallagher knocked Allen out of time on Carroll Island near St. Louis

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat James C. Gallagher on November 5, 1870, at a place printed as 'near the same ciry', presumably St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: Allen whipped James C. Gallagher nearthbe same ciry

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Mike McCoole near St. Louis on September 23, 1873, in nine rounds lasting twenty minutes.
claims.excerpt: near St. Louis, in nine rounds, lasting twenty minutes

claims.statement: Joe Goss beat Tom Allen in Kentucky on September 7, 1876, in twenty-one rounds lasting fifty-three minutes.
claims.excerpt: On September 7, 1876, Joe Gogs and Allen | had a fight for the te gent in Kentucky.

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Joe Goss were arrested after their September 7, 1876 fight in Kentucky.
claims.excerpt: Goss won in twenty-one rounds; time, fitty-— three minutes. The principals were arrested.

claims.statement: After the Goss fight, Tom Allen gave bonds.
